# std.regex

<!-- Generated by `lang doc std` from the checked interfaces (lang 0.1.0). Do not edit by hand. -->

Regular expressions (the Rust `regex` syntax; no backreferences or
lookaround, and matching takes linear time).

`compile` checks a pattern and reports an invalid one as an `Error`; the
functions taking a pattern string treat an invalid pattern as a defect of
the caller. Compiled patterns are cached.

## Types

```lang
struct Error { pub pattern: String, pub message: String }
```

A pattern that does not compile.

